params.gender: <c>male</c> or <c>female</c>; any case; anything else fails

params.bodyTypeDefName: a BodyTypeDef name, any case: vanilla has <c>Male</c>, <c>Female</c>, <c>Thin</c>, <c>Fat</c>, <c>Hulk</c>, <c>Child</c>, <c>Baby</c>; a mod may add more

step: is at the {word} stage of life

params.stage: <c>Baby</c>, <c>Newborn</c>, <c>Child</c> or <c>Adult</c>; any case; the first three need Biotech

params.direction: <c>North</c>, <c>East</c>, <c>South</c> or <c>West</c>; any case; anything else fails

params.name: the short name of the animal (for example a <c>coat-N</c> name)
params.direction: <c>North</c>, <c>East</c>, <c>South</c> or <c>West</c>; any case; anything else fails

params.name: the short name of a colonist or of an animal
params.direction: <c>North</c>, <c>East</c>, <c>South</c> or <c>West</c>; any case; anything else fails

params.kit: <c>smile</c> (MouthSmile, LidCheerful, BrowEven, SkinRosyCheeks), <c>calm</c> (MouthLipsTinySmile, LidSimple, BrowEven), <c>sad</c> (MouthSad, LidUnimpressed, BrowRaised), <c>angry</c> (MouthScowl, LidHardened, BrowTriangle), <c>smug</c> (MouthSmug, LidFlirty, BrowEven), <c>neutral</c> (MouthSimpleMouth, LidSimple, BrowEven); any case

params.typeName: a MouthTypeDef name; the valid names by mod are in ColonistRace/docs/FACE-PARTS.md (Mouths), a wrong name fails with the list
a LidOptionTypeDef name; see ColonistRace/docs/FACE-PARTS.md (Lid options)
an EmotionTypeDef name; see ColonistRace/docs/FACE-PARTS.md (Emotion marks)
a Facial Animation HeadTypeDef name (not the game's head type); see ColonistRace/docs/FACE-PARTS.md (Head shapes)
a MouthTypeDef name, as the mouth step takes it

params.animationName: one FaceAnimationDef name, or several joined by <c>+</c> (the last one that defines a part of the face wins); the 55 names by mod are in ColonistRace/docs/FACIAL-ANIMATIONS.md, a wrong name fails with the list

step: RIMMSQOL shows the main button {string} as {word}

params.state: <c>visible</c> or <c>hidden</c>, lower case; anything else fails

step: settings file records the main button {string} as {word}

params.state: <c>visible</c> or <c>hidden</c>, lower case; anything else fails

params.nickname: the nickname of a prisoner of the colony
params.modeName: a PrisonerInteractionModeDef defName; a wrong name fails with the list of the defs of this game

params.tabName: the type name of the tab (<c>ITab_Pawn_Gear</c>), its label key (<c>TabGear</c>), or the short form (<c>Gear</c>, <c>Bio</c>, <c>Health</c>, <c>Social</c>, <c>Needs</c>, <c>Log</c>); never the translated label; a name that matches no tab fails with the tabs of the selection

params.keep: the short name of the one human to keep; fails when no pawn has it
